children.text: Japanese American singer, dancer, and composer whose career is deeply entangled with Asian American cultural organizing. Her work sits at the crossroads of performance and movement history, showing how a song can behave like an archive and a living practice that keeps stories in circulation.

, a project that gathers Japanese American memory — especially the pressures, survival strategies, and inherited silences around incarceration — and turns it into a shared repertoire. Listen for how the music holds emotion without flattening it, and how the performance voice carries something larger than one individual speaker.
